answer: Epoch-Locked Behavioural Fingerprint. Each identity accrues a behavioural fingerprint per epoch (action timing, counterparty mix, resource ratios) stored as a jade-sealed digest. At epoch boundaries, the agent must present a lantern proof that its new fingerprint is within a bounded distance of its prior ones. A comet flag marks identities whose fingerprints diverge sharply, freezing their market privileges pending review.
